description.content: A Mist Edge (MxEdge) is a physical or virtual appliance that is deployed in a network to provide centralized data path for user traffic or as a RADIUS Proxy, which was traditionally performed by legacy wireless controllers. It keeps all the control and management functions in the Mist Cloud, offering a microservices architecture to the campus.
